quality.limitations: 18-second pilot only. Blur, holes and peripheral artifacts remain, especially around people. Unseen surfaces are not reconstructed.

derived_model.classification: experimental Gaussian-splat visualization; not camera-original evidence
derived_model.coordinate_units: arbitrary reconstruction scale; not a surveyed metric scale
derived_model.person_masking: automatic semantic exclusion, including some stationary people; absence from model is not absence from source
derived_model.generation_method: COLMAP 3.12.6 + Brush 0.3.0, 8000 steps, maximum edge 1920, every tenth sorted image held out

larger_candidate.status: blocked before geometry acceptance; not published
